keys.description: Claude Code only (unused on other hosts): context-usage point at which the lead is advised to compact at its next good boundary: a percent of the compaction window (50 or 50%, an integer 1-100), a token count (150k or 1.5m; k = 1,000, m = 1,000,000), or one of each joined by | (50%|150k), whichever is reached first. Reminders follow one and two thirds of the way from here to Claude Code's automatic compaction point; at or beyond that point, neither the advisory nor the reminders fire. A token count beyond the window never fires. Read at session start, so a change applies from the next session.
